name: @local/dsh-mcp-server
description: Expose DeepSeek Harness sessions, agents, and tools to any other agent harness over the Model Context Protocol.
author: baitouwuya

meta.title: DSH MCP Server
meta.description: Serves a Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint from the running DeepSeek Harness host, so other agent harnesses can start DSH sessions, continue them, and read their transcripts.

scripts.test: node test/mcp-self-test.mjs && node test/plugin-integration-test.mjs && node test/client-half-test.mjs
scripts.test:compat: node test/compat/follow-regression.mjs && node test/compat/bridge-regression.mjs && node test/compat/host-security-regression.mjs
